text:
maya: Heads up — PR ready for eval-pipeline config + orchestration changes. Touches runtime routing and KMS config; need runtime + platform + security eyes before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4250

sam: Pinging runtime + platform. @chris @leo can you take a quick look? what's the rough blast radius?

maya: Link above — changes are: add `eval_batch_runner` job, switch routing to runtime v2 fallback path, and reference a KMS key for job credentials (no plaintext secrets). Also adds a small KV cache warmup hook.

chris: On it, I can look first thing tomorrow. My main concerns: fallback semantics (we need deterministic timeout) and KV warmup that might impact cold-start latency. Any perf numbers?

ci-bot: CI: integration-tests failed (run 4) — flaky timeout in eval_runner_test. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/525/logs/7

maya: I noticed that flaky timeout locally and pushed a tiny sleep fix in 4251 that should help; 4250 depends on it. Can we rerun CI with `rerun=serial` after the dependency lands?

sam: @anya can you sanity-check the KMS auth/cross-account assumptions? Also need platform signoff on resource limits @leo.

anya: Quick pass: KMS usage pattern looks fine but we need to ensure access is scoped to the eval-service role and that key rotation is covered. Please add the policy snippet (least-privilege) and mention key rotation window in the PR description. I'll re-review after that.

leo: Resource limits note — default vCPU request looks high for the initial canary. Suggest dropping request from 0.5 -> 0.25 and add a `canary: true` toggle in the job config so we can roll out gradually. Also please add a short runbook step for aborting the canary.

chris: I pulled the branch and ran a quick smoke. Two small orchestration nits: 1) add an explicit fallback timeout param (so platform can tune without code change), 2) add a routing log prefix so we can filter traces by eval jobs. If those addressed I'm +1 pending green CI/canary.

maya: Thanks — I'll push a follow-up with the policy snippet, lowered vCPU, canary toggle, and the fallback timeout + log prefix. Can we do a manual canary run after CI? @infra-bot can you queue a canary run when CI passes?

infra-bot: Scheduled: canary run queued and will start after CI passes. Estimated start ~10m post-CI green.

sam: :thumbsup: Sounds good. @chris @anya please mark when you leave LGTM and I'll gate merge after canary + green CI.

chris: LGTM (once CI and canary pass).

anya: LGTM from security after policy snippet in latest push.
